statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let z := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.sqrt X / 2; ∀ (X p : ℕ), 4096 ≤ X → p ∈ w X → z X ≤ (p+2).minFac → (p+2).Prime ∨ (∃ r s : ℕ, r.Prime ∧ s.Prime ∧ z X ≤ r ∧ r ≤ s ∧ r ≤ Nat.sqrt (2*X+2) ∧ p+2=r*s)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0067 · 给近平方根筛余值确定精确的素因子形状
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0067 · Classify the factors of survivors near the square-root cutoff

brief.zh: 先证 z≥32 且 z³>2X+2。若 p+2 含三个带重数的素因子，其乘积至少 z³。按最小素因子写剩下两因子的情形，保留平方分支。
brief.en: First prove z≥32 and z³>2X+2. Three prime factors counted with multiplicity would force a product of at least z³. The conclusion keeps the prime-square branch, then separates distinct two-prime products.
